_description: Editable backend config. JSON does not support comments, so _description fields document each path.

server._description: Electron starts the backend on this localhost API address.

paths._description: input_root is the external source data root, usually the T7 NSTORM folder. output_root is the generated backend data root, currently this project's data folder.
paths._input_paths: Source/input paths. Relative values are resolved under input_root.
paths._output_paths: Generated/output paths. Relative values are resolved under output_root.
